posts.community: VRL Logistics - value unlocking due to promoter actions
posts.text: VRL Logistics looks reasonably priced at current levels, with a few triggers lined up: Management is guiding 6–8% volume growth, and given the operating leverage in the business, PAT could grow 1.5–2x that Q1 only partly captured the freight hike they took after the crude spike. Q2 should see the full impact, so I’m expecting a better bottom line They’re using surplus cash to open owned branches, which should bring lease costs down over time New trucks are being added, part of it for capacity and part for better efficiency The 5% buyback alone should add roughly 5% to EPS over the next year Pu…
